dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 王明，我在学校前面。你家在哪儿？
dialogue.reading: Wáng Míng, wǒ zài xuéxiào qiánmian. Nǐ jiā zài nǎr?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Yīzhí zǒu, dào lùkǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 好，往左拐。那儿有一个超市！
dialogue.reading: Hǎo, wǎng zuǒ guǎi. Nàr yǒu yī ge chāoshì!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Duì! Wǒ jiā zài chāoshì yòubian.
